title: Rank blend with weights tuned by inner CV
spec: Inside fit_predict, run a 3-fold inner CV on the training set, with folds grouped by Murcko scaffold via GroupKFold, to get out-of-fold RF and MLP predictions. Pick the blend weight w from {0.2,0.35,0.5,0.65,0.8} that maximizes inner AUROC. Then fit on all training data and blend the test ranks with w. Watch the runtime and use 2 MLP seeds in the inner loop.

title: Diverse MLP ensemble
spec: Replace the 5 identical-shape MLPs with 6 MLPs that cycle through hidden_layer_sizes (256,64), (128,), (512,128) and alpha values 1e-3, 1e-2, 1e-1. Each uses a different seed. Average their probabilities, then rank-blend with the tree model as before. Keep total runtime low by using max_iter=150.

title: Tanimoto-kernel SVM
spec: Precompute the Tanimoto kernel on Morgan count/bit fingerprints (minmax kernel), SVC(kernel='precomputed', C=1, probability=True). Test kernel against the train set.

title: Gasteiger charge/ MQN features
spec: Add rdkit.Chem.rdMolDescriptors.MQNs_ (42 molecular quantum numbers) and CalcNumAmideBonds etc. to descriptors and Morgan counts; RF.

title: Replicate ExtraTrees replacing RF
spec: In fit_predict, replace RandomForestClassifier with ExtraTreesClassifier(n_estimators=1000, max_features=0.5, min_samples_leaf=1, n_jobs=8, random_state=seed) on descriptors+Gobbi features, keeping the 5-seed MLP and 50/50 rank blend unchanged. Purpose is a clean replicate of the earlier 0.0890 result. Keep runtime under 10 minutes.

title: Diverse MLP ensemble
spec: Replace the 5 identical-architecture MLPs with 6 MLPs cycling through hidden_layer_sizes (256,64), (512,), (128,128), (256,128,32) and alpha in {1e-3,1e-2,1e-1}, each with a different random_state. Keep early_stopping=True and the average of predicted probabilities. Keep runtime under 10 min.

title: CatBoost third blend member
spec: Add CatBoostClassifier(iterations=600, depth=6, learning_rate=0.05, l2_leaf_reg=5, random_seed=seed, verbose=0, thread_count=8) trained on the descriptor matrix only (no pharmacophore bits, to keep it fast). Rank-normalize its probabilities and average with the RF and MLP at weights 1/3 each.

title: Rank-transform of the RF with a kNN Tanimoto member
spec: Add a third blend member: a KNeighborsClassifier (k=15, distance-weighted, metric jaccard) on 2048-bit Morgan radius-2 bit vectors computed with the RDKit generator. Rank-normalize its probabilities and blend all three with equal weights 1/3.

title: Stacking with logistic meta-learner on inner out-of-fold predictions
spec: Inside fit_predict, run a 5-fold StratifiedKFold(seed) on the training set to get out-of-fold RF and MLP probabilities (use 3 MLP seeds for speed), fit LogisticRegression on logit of these two columns, then fit full RF/MLP and apply the meta-learner to test predictions instead of fixed 0.5/0.5 rank averaging. Check runtime stays under 10 minutes; reduce RF trees to 200 if needed.

title: Custom compact physchem features
spec: Hand-pick features: TPSA, MolLogP, MolWt, NumHDonors, NumHAcceptors, NumRotatableBonds, formal charge, count of basic amines, carboxylic acids, aromatic rings, fraction sp3, and halogen count. Fit gradient boosting (HistGradientBoostingClassifier, max_depth 3, lr 0.05, 200 iters).

title: LightGBM on descriptors+FP
spec: Replace RF with LGBMClassifier (n_estimators 400, learning_rate 0.03, num_leaves 15, colsample_bytree 0.3, subsample 0.8 with subsample_freq 1, min_child_samples 10, random_state seed, n_jobs 8) on RDKit descriptors plus Morgan counts of radius 2 with 1024 bits.

title: Mixup-augmented MLP training
spec: For the MLP branch, build an augmented training set by creating 2x as many mixed samples as original rows: pick random pairs (rng seeded from seed), lambda drawn from Beta(0.4,0.4), mixed input = lambda*xi+(1-lambda)*xj on the quantile-normal matrix, and target the mixed label. Train MLPRegressor (5 seeds) on the original plus mixed rows with those soft targets, and rank-average with RF.

title: Atom-pair kNN member
spec: Add a kNN member (k=15, Tanimoto similarity) on 2048-bit atom-pair fingerprint bits as an additional blend member alongside RF, MLP and the Morgan kNN, rank-averaged equally. Diversifies the similarity view.

title: Stacked blend weights via inner scaffold-free CV
spec: Inside fit_predict, run a 4-fold StratifiedKFold on the training data to get out-of-fold predictions for RF and MLP (one MLP seed to save time), then fit a LogisticRegression on the two OOF rank-transformed predictions and use its coefficients to weight the final blend of test predictions. Watch runtime; reduce n_estimators to 200 for inner folds if needed.

title: Acid/base and BBB-rule substructure features
spec: Append a small set of hand-made features to featurize: counts of carboxylic acid, sulfonamide, tetrazole, basic aliphatic amine (tertiary/secondary), quaternary N, phenol, and amide via SMARTS patterns with mol.GetSubstructMatches; plus TPSA/MW, HBD+HBA, and a flag for CNS MPO-like rules (TPSA<90, MW<450, HBD<=3). Stack with existing features.

title: Descriptors + counts with ExtraTrees
spec: Swap RandomForest for ExtraTreesClassifier (500 trees, max_features 0.3) on concatenated RDKit descriptors and count Morgan features.

title: SVD-compressed MLP input
spec: For the MLP branch only, apply TruncatedSVD or PCA with 128 components to the quantile-normal matrix (fit on the train fold), then train the 5-seed MLP on the compressed features, with hidden layers (128,32) and alpha 1e-2. The RF keeps raw features. Rank-blend 50/50.

title: kNN k tuning with similarity weighting
spec: On top of the RF+MLP+Morgan-kNN blend, change the kNN to k=25 with weights equal to similarity cubed, computed with a dense Tanimoto matrix via matrix products on Morgan bits (radius 2, 2048). Keep equal rank blend of three members.
